request.candidate: Subject of the email: Revised Q2 Budget and Profit Forecast.   Body: Hi Jordan,  After our review of the Q1 performance and taking into account the upcoming market trends, we have made some adjustments to our Q2 budget. The revisions include a shift of funds towards emerging market bonds, which we believe will offer a better return this quarter.  The attached spreadsheet includes all the changes. Notably, our profit forecast for Q2 has been revised to a figure of $9.378 million, which reflects a 3.5% increase from our previous estimates.  Please review and confirm your agreement with these changes.  Warm regards, Karen Smith Chief Financial Officer, Corporate Finance Ltd.
